entities.name: Tomb of Urami
entities.description: Gateway in the swamps of Takenuma on Kamigawa through which the oni Urami erupts to feed.

entities.name: Urami
entities.description: Oni who struck a deal with ogre-magi for food and kept them in servitude.

entities.name: Ogre-magi
entities.description: Ogres who built Urami's gateway and lured people to it.

events.summary: Urami strikes a deal with ogre-magi, promising forbidden secrets for free reign to consume their lands, but never keeps his end.
events.quote: The oni never fulfilled his end of the bargain

events.summary: The ogres construct a gateway through which Urami erupts to feed.
events.quote: The ogres constructed a gateway through which Urami erupted to feed

events.summary: The ogres mark the gate as a tomb and spread rumors of Urami's demise to lure people.

relations.quote: preferring instead to keep the ogres in perpetual servitude
